title: Flames and Meetings
overview: Gobancho's Chinese Restaurant is the best Chinese restaurant in Tokyo, though some might dispute that.

title: They're Like Gunpowder
overview: An infamous food critic shows up at Gobancho's, but may have met his match in Jan and Kiriko.

title: A Loser's Cry of Victory
overview: A mistake in the kitchen leads to Jan reminiscing about what brought him to Gobancho's.

title: He Who Masters Poison
overview: Sparks continue to fly between Jan and Kiriko, while Otani attempts to get revenge.

title: The Magic of Bliss
overview: Otani launches a Chinese cooking competition in hopes of getting revenge on Jan.

title: The Soul of Chinese Cooking
overview: The tournament is underway, as Jan takes on the fiery cooking of Sawada Kei.

title: Toss That Wok!
overview: Jan takes on the scientific cooking approach of Kawahara Yuji.

title: Malice
overview: Jan faces Omae Kotaro, a hard-working, earnest chef who is out to make his hometown proud.

title: Innovating for the Future
overview: The finalists begin their battle in the All-Japan Chinese Chef Championship.

title: The Judges' Focus
overview: Jan, Kiriko, and Celene face off over their noodle dishes in the first stage of the final round.
